criterion_bindings.exemption: Digest binding is a surface-identity property enforced by the generated drift validator scripts/check-agent-contracts.py over the generated contracts and manifest.
Generated-artifact unity is enforced by the validator's generated-drift checks in scripts/check-agent-contracts.py, which fail when the manifest and its artifacts disagree.

Fail-closed digest mismatch is an envelope-and-adapter property. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeRejectsUnknownVariantsAndFields (internal/agent/envelope_test.go) and the strict unknown-input rejection of adapter/opencode/generated-contract-tests.ts.
